scripts.backend: cd backend && PORT="${PORT:-$(node ../scripts/select-port.mjs 8765)}" npm run dev
scripts.dev: PORT="${PORT:-$(node scripts/select-port.mjs 8765)}"; VITE_PORT="${VITE_PORT:-$(node scripts/select-port.mjs 5173)}"; CLIENT_URL="$(VITE_PORT="$VITE_PORT" node -e 'const os=require("node:os"),p=process.env.VITE_PORT; const hosts=Object.values(os.networkInterfaces()).flat().filter((i)=>i && i.family==="IPv4" && !i.internal && !/^(docker|veth|br-)/.test(i.address)).map((i)=>i.address); process.stdout.write(["http://localhost:"+p,"http://127.0.0.1:"+p,...new Set(hosts.map((h)=>"http://"+h+":"+p))].join(","))')"; export PORT VITE_PORT CLIENT_URL VITE_API_PROXY_TARGET="http://127.0.0.1:$PORT"; concurrently --kill-others-on-fail npm:backend npm:frontend
